commonSetup: arch=$(uname -m); case "$arch" in x86_64) arch=x64 ;; aarch64) arch=arm64 ;; esac; tarball=$(curl -fsSL https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/SHASUMS256.txt | awk '{print $2}' | grep -E "^node-v[0-9.]+-linux-$arch\.tar\.xz$"); curl -fsSL "https://nodejs.org/dist/latest-v24.x/$tarball" | tar -xJ -C /usr/local --strip-components=1 --exclude=CHANGELOG.md --exclude=LICENSE --exclude=README.md && node --version && npm --version

toolchains.description: gcc, g++, clang, gdb, CMake, Ninja

root.debian: export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends gcc g++ clang gdb cmake ninja-build pkg-config && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
root.fedora: dnf install -y gcc gcc-c++ clang gdb cmake ninja-build pkgconf-pkg-config && dnf clean all
root.arch: pacman -Syu --noconfirm --needed gcc clang gdb cmake ninja pkgconf && pacman -Scc --noconfirm

root.debian:
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive && apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends libicu-dev && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && curl -fsSL https://dot.net/v1/dotnet-install.sh -o /tmp/dotnet-install.sh && bash /tmp/dotnet-install.sh --channel 10.0 --install-dir /usr/local/share/dotnet && rm /tmp/dotnet-install.sh && ln -sf /usr/local/share/dotnet/dotnet /usr/local/bin/dotnet && printf 'export DOTNET_ROOT=/usr/local/share/dotnet
export DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT=1
export PATH="$PATH:$HOME/.dotnet/tools"
' > /etc/profile.d/gits-dotnet.sh
